judgement.reason: A Laravel invoicing web app on MySQL with S3 uploads, needing a contained change to split the s6 scheduler into a worker, fits Deployz.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: docker/production/Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with a web server and a worker service (scheduler) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The serversideup image runs the scheduler inside the web container by default, and no shown line turns it off, so the scheduler still has to be set up as a separate worker.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares database (mariadb:10) in docker/production/docker-compose.mysql.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is MariaDB, a MySQL-compatible database that the app reaches through the DB_* settings, so the managed MySQL that Deployz provides can replace it.
